project.title: GP120 Mass Spectrometry Data to Analyse N-Glycosylation
project.projectDescription: Analysis of gp120 N-glycosylation. N-linked glycosylation sites of gp120 were interrogated for the presence of 55 glycoforms from chronic vs acute HIV virions.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein bands were excised from SDS-PAGE gels, processed as per standard proteomics methods using trypsin and chymotrypsin and iodoacetamide. Peptides were analysed by EThcD with trigger of ETD scans from oxonium ions found in HCD scans.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: RAW files were converted to mzXML and analysed in GlycoPAT software, found in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15757230. The false discovery rate was <1% and the ensemble score was set at > 2 times the decoy score.
